headline: Find Hub on Wear OS now lets you locate people directly from your watch
summary: The 'Find People' feature, previously exclusive to Android phones, is now available on smartwatches, offering real-time location sharing and navigation.
details: Google's Find Hub, a crucial tool for tracking compatible devices like phones, smart tags, and earbuds, is expanding its capabilities on Wear OS.
The 'Find People' feature, which allows users to share and request locations with friends and family, has been a staple on Android for some time.
Now, Wear OS smartwatch users can activate this feature directly from their wrist, enabling real-time location data sharing and navigation.
Users have granular control over their privacy, with options to immediately stop sharing their location, block unwanted users, and filter contacts.
While the feature is functional, a dedicated map view is currently absent on Wear OS, requiring users to switch to their phone for visual tracking.
This update is available through the latest version of the Find Hub app on the Google Play Store, with version 1.0.429.0 confirmed to support the feature.
Find Hub also offers broader device management, including the ability to secure, lock, or erase devices, and can even alert users to unknown trackers.
caption:
Never lose track of your friends again. Google's Find Hub is bringing its 'Find People' feature to Wear OS smartwatches.

Google's Find Hub, a crucial tool for tracking compatible devices like phones, smart tags, and earbuds, is expanding its capabilities on Wear OS.

The 'Find People' feature, which allows users to share and request locations with friends and family, has been a staple on Android for some time.

Now, Wear OS smartwatch users can activate this feature directly from their wrist, enabling real-time location data sharing and navigation.

Users have granular control over their privacy, with options to immediately stop sharing their location, block unwanted users, and filter contacts.

While the feature is functional, a dedicated map view is currently absent on Wear OS, requiring users to switch to their phone for visual tracking.

This update is available through the latest version of the Find Hub app on the Google Play Store, with version 1.0.429.0 confirmed to support the feature.

Find Hub also offers broader device management, including the ability to secure, lock, or erase devices, and can even alert users to unknown trackers.
